en:
What? You're a loan shark, too!? Oh, I get it. You seem all
friendly at first, then watch, you're going to bleed me dry
just like the rest of them!
Now, now. Just hear me out.

The loan sharks and I are a little different when it comes
to loan applications. I have only one condition⑬that you
pass the test I assign.
Test?

Right. If you pass, you qualify for a loan with no maximum
limit, no interest, and no collateral. That's our specialty.

No limit? No interest, no collateral? How is that even
possible?

Let me worry about that. So, what do you say? Care to take
my test?
Er⑬ Yes! Yes, please!
Okay then, let's get to work. Your test is simple.

Go to the lender's office right now, and tell them you're
going to a lawyer.

But, I can't! I told you, if I so much as think about
talking to a lawyer, they'll kill me! Why would you make me
do that!?

You can whine all you want, but that's my test. It's up to
you. You in or out?
Urk... But...

Look, you weren't doing a very good job, but you were
trying to kill yourself, right?

Try using that nothing-left-to-lose attitude to face your
problem head-on, not run away from it. This could be your
last chance, you know.
Akiyama-san, I...
Okay, I get it. I'll do it.
Great, let's not waste any time. Where's their office?
They're over in West Shofukucho.

Good. Off you go, then. Don't worry, I'm with you all the
way. If they kill you, I'll spring for your funeral.
Thank you.... Okay. Here I go!

(Will he actually go through with this? He said the lender's
in West Shofukucho. I'd better go take a look.)
So how'd it feel, staring death in the face?
It was so scary, I thought I was about to lose it...

Heh, I'm not surprised. Good going, though. You passed my
test with flying colors.
Hah. Ahahaha... I did it.

So? You understand? We just want to be friends with you,
Sasamoto-kun.

When you start talking about a lawyer, it kinda hurts our
feelings... Get it, shithead!?
Gffh, urgh... Yeah... I get it.
Oh, good. We're on the same page, then? That's great!

No... I  mean I get it now⑬what it means to use my
nothing-left-to-lose attitude.

I'm going to get my life back together! I'm not going to
cower and hide anymore!

I'm not giving in to scum like you! I'm ready to die! You
want to kill me? Go ahead and do it!
Bastard...
Well said. I wasn't expecting that.
Oh! Hey! You morons! Which one of you left the door open?

Uh, mind telling us who you are? We're in a meeting, so we'd
appreciate it if you could return some other time.

Oh, I'm afraid I can't do that. He's my customer. I'd be out some
business if he were to go dying on me, so I'd like you to let him go.

Customer? Wait, you tellin' me you put him up to this? He's
been a real pain in the ass, you know.

I thought it was weird this limp dick would try pullin' a
stunt like that. I wish you hadn't encouraged him. He's
gonna be our own personal ATM for a long time.
Your personal ATM, huh? Let me ask you⑬why are you in this business?

What kind of a dumb question is that? What else but the
money? Same as you.

Flipping other people's money to make more money... Funny
thing, I actually hate this business.

It's the people who need money to turn their lives
around⑬where money's their only hope. That's who I'm in
this for.
That's why I do what I do.

Wow, how noble. I don't give a flying fuck about your
dipshit dreams!

Your little speech gives me the creeps. Don't worry, though.
We're gonna make you beg for forgiveness, and then we're postin'
that shit all over the internet! Get him!

*pant* *pant* Come on, don't make me run. You want to get
kicked around some more?
Augh! Sorry, it was just instinct.
I'm beat. Can I go now?
Whatever ya want. Here, take this as a housewarmin' gift.
You better not go for my pockets again.
I won't. I'm exhausted.
You got <Color:8>Tattered Scarf<Color:Default>.
Well, lemme know if ya ever need a hand! Be seein' ya!
(Good grief. It's always tough moving to a new town.)

*pant* *pant* You sure can fight. Where'd you learn to move
like that, eh?
Thanks. Are we good now?

Yeah. Glad we sorted out this misunderstandin'. Here, lemme
give ya a little something...
Huh? Wait, my wallet! Hold on a second!
Are you looking for Sky Finance?
Huh? Oh, hi there. That's right. How'd ya know?
I just heard you asking about it.

I see. I shoulda guessed. I am indeed lookin' for a place
called Sky Finance. Do you know it?
Yeah, it's right over there.
Ah, it was right there all along, huh? Haha, silly me.
Oh, and you're looking at the owner.

The name's Akiyama. I'm the president of Sky Finance.
Looking to take out a loan?

You motherfucker! So you're the piece of shit who thinks he
can just start up his own moneylendin' gig here!?
Wait, what? Yeah, that's me. Why?

Like we're gonna let you get away with that! We don't want
no shady types around here, ya feel me!? It'll ruin the
city!

There are tons of other moneylenders in the area. What about
them?

Shut it! We don't take kindly to outsiders tellin' us how to
run business here! Now pack up shop, and get your greasy ass
out of our town!

Look, I've already got everything cleared with the city
office.

Like I give a fuck! You're handin' out zero interest,
indefinite term loans, right?

Ya got another thing comin' if ya think that shit'll fly
around here.

Okay, pal, I get it. You're a local competitor, and you've
come to chase me off? That right?

Well, you needn't worry. We target a different type of
clientele. I doubt we'll interfere with your business.

Did I say you could talk, jerkwad? I ain't here to chew the
fat with ya. I'm tellin' ya to piss off, or else!

Well, I'm afraid you're wasting your time. I'll have to ask you
to leave. You wouldn't want to cause a disturbance, now
would you?

You're gonna regret this. Fine, if you ain't gonna listen,
prepare to meet your maker!

Ya wouldn't happen to know where Sky Finance is, would ya? I
hear it's around here somewhere.
Sky Finance? Never heard of it.
I see. Sorry to bother ya.
Wish I could be of more help.
(He's looking for us? Could be a new client...)
Akiyama-san! We did it! We got our new menu items!
Oh, that's great to hear. What are they, if I may ask?

I was just about to say. We decided to go with mentaiko,
salmon, and chicken wings.

Akiyama-san, your advice was spot-on in every way. Thank you
so very much!
Oh, all the ideas worked? That's great.
Oh, I see. Guess I wasn't very useful to you, huh?

No, no. The ideas for all three came to me from the places
your acquaintances hail from.

Mentaiko from Fukuoka, salmon from Hokkaido, and chicken
wings⑬which we're shapin' into a unique little tulip
shape⑬from Nagoya.

Oh, I see. The new items are from the three cities. Heh,
looks like I was somewhat useful after all.

Oh, so mentaiko's in. The other ideas weren't too useful,
I'm guessing?

No, no. The ideas for the other two came to me from the
places your acquaintances hail from.

Salmon's from Hokkaido, and chicken wings⑬which we're
shapin' into a unique little tulip shape⑬are from Nagoya.
Oh, I see. Heh, looks like I was somewhat useful after all.

Oh, so salmon's in. The other ideas weren't too useful, I'm
guessing?

Mentaiko's from Fukuoka, and chicken wings⑬which we're
shapin' into a unique little tulip shape⑬are from Nagoya.
Oh, so chicken wings are in.

Yeah. We decided to cut the wings into a unique little tulip
shape.
I see. The other ideas weren't too useful, I'm guessing?
Mentaiko's from Fukuoka, and salmon's from Hokkaido.
Oh, you went with mentaiko and salmon.
I did! Your advice was invaluable, Akiyama-san.

Actually, chicken wings, too. We're gonna give 'em a unique
tulip shape.
I got the idea from your acquaintance from Nagoya.

Haha, that's giving me undue credit. But I'm glad I could be
of service.
Oh, you went with mentaiko and chicken wings.

Actually, salmon, too. I got the idea from your acquaintance
from Hokkaido.
Oh, you went with salmon and chicken wings.

Actually, mentaiko, too. I got the idea from your acquaintance
from Fukuoka.

Akiyama-san, I owe ya so much for what you've done. Whaddya
say to joinin' me at my company?

That's an attractive offer. If my business ever goes under,
I'll definitely look you up.

Haha, nah, you're way too on top of things. I doubt we'll
see the day.

It's not much, but think of it as a little show of my
appreciation. Thank you kindly.
You got a <Color:8>Cod Roe Blackjack<Color:Default>.
All right, I gotta get goin'. Come eat with us again soon!
(Heh, he's an energetic one.)
Chairman Ueyama-san.

Ah, Akiyama-san. How's it goin'? Rustle up any ideas for
some new kushikatsu items?

Yes. I spoke with some acquaintances who had been living in
Fukuoka, Hokkaido, and Nagoya.
Great! And?
My Fukuoka acquaintance suggested mizutaki stew.
Hmm? Mizutaki stew, ya say? I dunno 'bout that...
Oh. Okay.
My Fukuoka acquaintance suggested mentaiko⑬spicy fish roe.
Hm, hm... Mentaiko, huh? That's a good one!
Oh, good. Here's hoping it works.
My Fukuoka acquaintance suggested, uh, soba noodles.

Soba... Did he really? What's that got to do with Fukuoka? I
ain't too sure about that one...
That's fair...
Next, my acquaintance from Hokkaido suggested rabbit.

Rabbit? That's a curveball. Not sayin' it's a bad
ingredient, but it doesn't sound quite right.
Hmm, fair enough.
Next, my acquaintance from Hokkaido suggested bear.

Now that's a big idea. Has a kick to it, but it's a bit
much, if you ask me.
Yeah, I thought so, too.
Next, my acquaintance from Hokkaido suggested salmon.

Ah, yes! Salmon! That does sound good for fryin' on a
skewer.

Yeah, salmon is pretty tasty, isn't it? I'm glad you like
the idea.

And finally, my Nagoya acquaintance said... Uh... How's miso
bean paste strike you?
You mean by itself?
Yes, that was my reaction, too.

Hmm. Does your acquaintance happen to have any odd eating
habits? Miso on its own's a no-go in my book.
Hey, mine too...
And finally, my Nagoya acquaintance suggested chicken wings.

Chicken wings. That makes sense! Yes, I'm sure that'll work
just fine!

I think so, too. Wings should work. I'm glad you like the
idea.

And finally, my Nagoya acquaintance said...  Uh... How about
some prawns?

Prawns? Why prawns from Nagoya...? Oh, I get it. He was
talkin' about deep-fried prawns, was he?
I think that's what he was going for, yeah.

Hmm. We already have prawns on the menu. It wouldn't exactly
be a new item.
Yeah. That probably wouldn't work, then.
That's about all I have for you.

Hm. Well, I'll take what ya told me and mull it over.
Appreciate the help!

Huh? Pardon me, but... aren't you Chairman Ueyama-san of
Kushikatsu Daruma? Yes, you are. How goes it?

Hm? Oh, ohh, if it ain't Akiyama-san! Thanks again for your
help over in Sotenbori.
What brings ya up this way? Some coincidence, runnin' into you here.
Yes, I'd have to agree. Are you here on business?

Yep. I'm sure I told ya before, but I'm tryin' to conjure up
a few new kushikatsu items⑬new eats to skewer and fry!

I thought I could turn specialties from various regions into
kushikatsu. So I've been on the road from Osaka to Tokyo,
samplin' food from just about everywhere.
The chairman in person? That's some dedication.

Yeah, but nothin's really doing it for me. The way things're
goin', I could be headin' home empty-handed... Hey, I know!
You look like you got a lotta friends, Akiyama.

Uh, I don't know about that. I do seem to have acquaintances
with pretty colorful backgrounds, though.

Well, then! Some of 'em must be from other cities with their
own local specialties, right? Think you could ask 'em for
me?
Oh, I see. Asking's easier than going there.

(Those guys weren't really born and raised in other regions,
but it wouldn't hurt to ask.)

Okay. I may have a few people I could prod for ideas. I'll
ask them.
Much appreciated! In the meantime, I'll be scoutin' around here.
Eep! What do you want?
You ladies talkin' 'bout Himura? The detective guy?
Excuse me, but who are you?
I'm... a friend of Himura's. Just haven't seen 'im in a while, so I'm wonderin' if anyone knows somethin'.
I see. Yes, it's probably the same man. But he's not a detective anymore.
He got arrested for bribery.
(Yep, that's him.)
Explains why I don't see 'im around. You were sayin' something else, though, weren't ya?
Uh, if you're his friend, I shouldn't...
